feed.title: Open MPC - Plugin Catalog: new releases

entry.title: Welle 0.3.1
entry.summary: Waldorf Wave emulation running from the original Wave OS - developed by Mookid. Styled faithfully to the original panel. Needs your own Wave OS 1.700 files, uploaded from the Plugin Manager.

entry.title: Osirus 0.2.11
entry.summary: An emulation of the Access Virus A, B and C synthesizers' original firmware (gearmulator's DSP56300 emulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a touchscreen skin, banks and patch browser, Q-Link control and knob values on every page. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Virus ROM.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.3.5
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: MS2KR 0.2.1
entry.summary: An emulation of the MS2000R analog-modeling synth's own firmware (ms2000r-emu) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a six-page touchscreen skin laid out like the front panel, live LCD, favourites and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own ROM dumps.

entry.title: MPC MIDI Converter 1.0.0
entry.summary: Converts MIDI files to MPC patterns right on the MPC, no computer needed. Browse your SD card and drives, convert one file or a whole pack with its subfolders, then load the patterns onto any track. Split tracks, map GM drums onto pads, quantize; each pattern's name carries the file's tempo. Gen1 (MPC OS 2.x and 3.x) and Gen2.

entry.title: Dexed 2.0.5
entry.summary: DX7-style 6-operator FM synth (Dexed/MSFA engine) as a native instrument, with .syx bank browsing, all 32 algorithm diagrams and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links.

entry.title: Warpline 1.0.0
entry.summary: Wavetable synth for standalone MPC built on the open-source Vital engine: plays .vital patches, 300 factory patches with type filter, velocity, six touchscreen pages.

entry.title: Vulcan Rotary 1.0.0
entry.summary: Six-barrel rotary gate and stutter: the barrels spool up from rest, rates in real gun rounds per minute (2,500 / 4,000 / 6,000 / 7,200).

entry.title: VHS Vibes 1.6.0
entry.summary: A worn video-tape effect: pitch wobble, tape saturation, generation loss, B-type noise reduction, hum, hiss and crackle, plus deck faults (level control, drift, tracking drop-outs) and a dry/wet mix. 34 programs, on a hot pink cassette with reels that turn.

entry.title: Tropix 0.1.6 (beta)
entry.summary: Island and afro ROMpler: 128 presets and 65 instruments for afrobeat, amapiano, kompa, soca, reggae and Hawaiian music - steel pans, log drums, saxes and trumpets, kompa and slack-key guitars, steels, keys, mallets, basses and percussion. Two layers, glide, horn scoop, vibrato, nine colorways. Also a VST3 (Mac, Windows) and Mac AU.

entry.title: Tributary 1.2.5
entry.summary: Sums chosen Elektron Overbridge outputs onto one MPC track over USB. The machine is 48 kHz; the track resamples that to the MPC's 44.1. Capture saves the machine's own 48 kHz samples, locked to the bars. Based on Overwitch.

entry.title: Sysex Bandit 1.0.1
entry.summary: Send and receive MIDI System Exclusive from a track: pick or hand-edit a .syx message, aim it at one output device, listen on one input and save what arrives. Makes no sound.

entry.title: Sonix 0.3.16 (beta)
entry.summary: A melodic ROMpler instrument for standalone Akai MPC devices, built as a native ARM VST2 plugin. Includes pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, leads, plucks, bass, bells, synth chords and effects, using redistributable sound libraries. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.

entry.title: Reverbicon 224 1.0.0
entry.summary: A Lexicon 224 running its own v4.4 firmware on an emulated machine (8080, DSP, converters and analog boards): six programs, the original sliders and LED readout. Needs your own ROMs.

entry.title: reMixXXL CUE 0.2.0 (beta)
entry.summary: Companion to reMixXXL: plays reMixXXL's PFL cue (decks 1/3 left, 2/4 right) on its own audio track routed to outputs 3/4, so you can beat match in the headphones while the main mix stays on 1/2. Needs reMixXXL 0.1.25 or later in the same project.

entry.title: reMixXXL 0.2.0 (beta)
entry.summary: Four Mixxx-engine DJ decks for the Force: CDJ-style jog wheels you spin with a finger (VINYL scratches, CDJ nudges the pitch), mixer, two effect units, a track browser, a phone/PC companion page and Mixxx controller maps, with a big-button touchscreen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.7 (beta)
entry.summary: A dark, cinematic instrument: choirs, winds, brass, strings, bells, piano, e-piano, harp, mallets, synths and textures from CC0 recordings, in two layered slots with filter, lo-fi, tempo-synced delay and motion, reverb and sub. 200 presets with a browser page; a CRT orb reacts as you play. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.3.4
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: Odin 2 1.4.10
entry.summary: Odin 2 synthesizer ported to standalone Akai MPC devices as a native VST2 plugin. Features Odin's original engine, 261 factory patches, touchscreen pages, automatic voice management and a CPU meter. Tested on an Akai MPC Live II; unofficial port. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.

entry.title: OB-Xd MPC 0.4.10 (beta)
entry.summary: OB-Xd, the Oberheim OB-X emulation: two oscillators with sync and cross-mod, a 12/24 dB filter, voice variation; 517 patches in 10 banks with a browser page, and your own .fxb banks. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.

entry.title: Nova Editor 0.7.2
entry.summary: An editor and librarian for the Novation MiniNova as a native plugin, with its own MPC screen skin: every control maps to a MiniNova CC/NRPN, controls follow the synth, banks A-C and imported .syx files live on the SD card. Also a SysEx librarian for any other synth. With nova-audio loaded, the MiniNova plays on the plugin's own track.

entry.title: MS2KR 0.2.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the MS2000R analog-modeling synth's own firmware (ms2000r-emu) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices, with a six-page touchscreen skin laid out like the front panel, live LCD, favourites and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own ROM dumps.

entry.title: Frodhes 0.9.13
entry.summary: A physically modelled electric piano, vibraphone and marimba, with no samples: 16 voices, 57 presets, drive, chorus, phaser, tremolo, wah, delay, reverb, EQ and a compressor.

entry.title: Fretty 0.8.7 (beta)
entry.summary: A guitar instrument with an animated fretboard: acoustic, electric, bass, harp, violin, zither and folk sounds with a synth layer, chorus and distortion. 110 presets with a browser page by category. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.

entry.title: FAST G BITCRUSHER – VICTORY EDITION 1.0.0 (beta)
entry.summary: Free vintage bitcrusher audio effect for Akai MPC.

entry.title: F4 Phantom 1.1.0
entry.summary: 8-voice subtractive synth: two oscillators plus sub, SVF filter, drift, stereo chorus and a six-barrel rotary gate. 14 sounds.

entry.title: DAVIS Spectral Sidechain 1.6.7
entry.summary: One-band sidechain dynamic EQ: the kick ducks the bass frequencies, with a live spectrum display and a touchscreen skin.

entry.title: Crate Digger 2.1.0
entry.summary: Dig for records by genre, style, decade, region and country on Discogs, then stream and play them into an MPC track, with its own screen skin and Q-Links.

entry.title: πMorpH 0.1.3
entry.summary: Polyphonic XY wavetable synthesizer with paths, orbit, dual envelopes, HP/LP filters, two LFOs and an eight-slot modulation matrix. Includes 100 presets plus INIT and Custom Wavetable import: mono/stereo PCM16, PCM32 or float32 WAV, 512/1024/2048 samples per waveform.

entry.title: Tuner 1.1.2
entry.summary: A chromatic tuner insert with a live needle drawn straight onto the MPC's screen at 20-24 fps: note, cents and Hz, A4 from 430 to 450 Hz, and a mute for silent tuning. It writes into MPC's display memory, which MPC OS doesn't offer plugins, so a firmware update could break it. Not affiliated with Akai.

entry.title: STUDIO424 1.0.0
entry.summary: Brings the warm, slightly rough sound of an old cassette four-track mixer to your MPC. Push it for crunch, or leave it clean for a little colour.

entry.title: Stompbox 1.1.2
entry.summary: A whole guitar rig from guitarix's DSP: gate, comp, wah, any number of pedals, amp, tone stack, power amp, cabinet with an IR loader, post FX, mod, delay, reverb and EQ. 219 models and guitarix's 40 factory presets in the PRESET menu. Not affiliated with guitarix.

entry.title: SQ8LMPC 0.2.0
entry.summary: SQ8L 0.91b (Ensoniq SQ-80 emulation by Siegfried Kullmann, based on sq8l-revival) on the Akai Force: same engine and sound, the SQ8L panel on one screen, 128 factory sounds, your own banks with SAVE, drop-in banks. Bring your own SQ-80 wave ROM (not included). Unofficial, free, non-commercial.

entry.title: Open MPC Plugin Manager 1.3.0
entry.summary: The official OpenMPC plugin manager for Gen1 and Gen2 MPCs (32-bit build for Force, Live, One, X, Key; 64-bit for the Live III and kin). Browse this catalog and install, update and remove plugins on the MPC itself, with rollback if an install fails. Built on poloq's mpc-vst-manager.

entry.title: NOXED MPC Plugins: 7 plugins updated
entry.summary: Acidline 0.3.0, MPC Overwitch 0.5.1, MPC Overwitch 0.5.0, MPC Overwitch Send 0.5.1, MPC USB Bridge 0.2.2, Prism Wave 0.1.4, Prism Wave 0.1.3

entry.title: NodalRed2x 0.2.0
entry.summary: An emulation of the Clavia Nord Lead 2x's original firmware (gearmulator) as a native instrument for Gen2 MPC devices: a native MPC screen laid out like the Nord's panel, a starter bank plus your own sound sets, RANDOM, named favourites in the PRESET menu and Q-Link control. Gen2 (aarch64) only; you need your own Nord Lead 2x ROM.

entry.title: NAM 1.1.2
entry.summary: Neural Amp Modeler captures as an insert effect, with cab IR, tone, gate, pitch, delay, reverb and an on-device TONE3000 downloader.

entry.title: NAM 1.1.1
entry.summary: Neural Amp Modeler captures as an insert effect, with cab IR, tone, gate, pitch, delay, reverb and an on-device TONE3000 downloader.

entry.title: MPC Commander 1.3.2
entry.summary: The plugins MPC loads, with their own skins, and MPC's transport, on a desktop app. Listens on the device only: reach it through an SSH tunnel (no login; bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network).

entry.title: LUFS VU 1.0.1
entry.summary: Stereo analog VU meters plus an EBU R 128 loudness tab: integrated, short-term and momentary LUFS, true peak and gain reduction. Optional AUTO loudness steers towards a target (-23 to -9 LUFS) and an optional true-peak limiter holds a ceiling. Selectable calibration, clip lamps, phase meter. With processing off the audio passes through bit-exact.

entry.title: LUFS VU 1.0.0
entry.summary: Stereo analog VU meters plus an EBU R 128 loudness tab: integrated, short-term and momentary LUFS, true peak and gain reduction. Optional AUTO loudness steers towards a target (-23 to -9 LUFS) and an optional true-peak limiter holds a ceiling. Selectable calibration, clip lamps, phase meter. With processing off the audio passes through bit-exact.

entry.title: Keyscope 1.1.2
entry.summary: Listens to any track and names its key, chord, bass note and tuning, from the spectrum of the whole mix; the audio passes through untouched.

entry.title: Jamiro 1.0.1
entry.summary: Novation X-Station-style polysynth (KS engine): 8 voices, 3 oscillators with sync, FM and ring mod, multimode filter, 2 envelopes, 2 LFOs, arpeggiator and effects. Loads your own X-Station/KS .syx banks from Content/Banks. Independent project, not affiliated with Novation.

entry.title: Jamiro 1.0.0
entry.summary: Novation X-Station-style polysynth (KS engine): 8 voices, 3 oscillators with sync, FM and ring mod, multimode filter, 2 envelopes, 2 LFOs, arpeggiator and effects. Loads your own X-Station/KS .syx banks from Content/Banks. Independent project, not affiliated with Novation.

entry.title: GPP Link 1.0.0
entry.summary: Send beats over Wi-Fi between your MPC or Force and a folder on your computer (macOS or Windows hub included), with a cassette deck to preview them. Opens a local-network HTTP hub with no password: home or studio networks only.

entry.title: Evil Tuner XXL 0.3.0 (beta)
entry.summary: Internet radio (30,000+ stations), or a phone over Wi-Fi or AirPlay, played into an MPC track through a granular engine, filter, character stages, delay, reverb, trance gate, stutter, tempo-synced looper and three LFOs. Inspired by the Endorphin.es Evil Pet (no affiliation, no code). Needs a network. 32-bit and 64-bit MPCs.

entry.title: ESQUE80 0.9.1
entry.summary: An 8-voice cross-wave synthesizer modelled on the Ensoniq SQ-80: three wavetable oscillators per voice, a 4-pole low-pass filter, four envelopes with touch-editable displays, three LFOs and a 15-source mod matrix, on an eleven-page skin with Q-Link banks per panel. Plays on built-in stand-in waves; add your own wave ROM for the original sound.

entry.title: Chordsmith 1.0.6
entry.summary: Chord tool: pads, keys or chord buttons play scale, set or custom chords with voicing, strum, arp and harp modes, MIDI out to other tracks and a built-in preview synth.
